notes.label: relative activation, not force
notes.copy: Normalized EMG supports comparison against an individual reference. It does not directly measure mechanical muscle force, so the interface must not imply more certainty than the signal provides.
notes.detail: Make the interpretation as careful as the measurement.

notes.label: keep the null result
notes.copy: The current models did not find a relationship between principle frequency and agreement. The broader similarity–relevance question remains open, and that boundary belongs in the work.
notes.detail: A non-result still narrows the question.

notes.label: show which objective moved
notes.copy: The course-assignment mechanism compares automation, efficiency, fairness, and preference satisfaction separately. Improving one outcome does not establish the others.
notes.detail: Name the tradeoff before optimizing it.

notes.label: test the intervention
notes.copy: The Shanghai map made access to nearby services more visible, but it was not formally user-tested. Design intent and demonstrated impact should stay distinct.

notes.label: make the workflow legible before changing it
notes.copy: Clarifying F1 test cases and mapping the existing WinTrace flow created the shared context needed for testing and design discussion. The same habit appears in maps, measurement pipelines, and allocation mechanisms.
notes.detail: First understand the system people already inhabit.
